conducting_body: CSIR-Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CMERI), Durgapur

Fitter: SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, minimum 55% marks
ITI certificate or national/state trade certificate in Fitter from a recognized institution
2 years’ full-time apprentice trainee experience in Fitter from a recognized institution
